About the Women's Monday Mountain Bike Ride group ride

A super casual no-drop trail ride for women on the Western Slope singletrack. Four to six miles of dirt and rock at a beginner pace with plenty of stops. Sign the Coalition's online waiver first; ride leaders can sort you out with a trail parking pass.

It's a no-drop ride. If you're slower than the group, someone waits. That's the whole point of a group ride.
